proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3208 kukkuṭa explicitly lists Bshk kukur and L./P. kukkuṛ/kukkaṛī cock/hen, with northern kukūĩ. These chicken responses fit the bird family, distinct from superficially similar dog words. Reviewed comparator: Dotyali kukurā “chicken” (f_st5p2opv3azic). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9828 manuṣya explicitly gives Bshk mīš/mĩš young man/husband with plural mānuš, and Palula mēš/mīš. These particular short-i forms are supported by the full entry; this does not resolve the separate Khowar moš ambiguity. Reviewed comparator: Chil meś “man” (f_axjoqhxqcvorq). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.

Reviewed comparator: Bshk tʰā “you (plural)” (f_krv2y2nwtv4pm). Uncertain intra-IA transmission remains open; exact source text is preserved.
